verdict.rationale:
Docs mention plan tiers and pricing (Premium $20/month, buying more credits) and note certain actions like chats.init() are 'fast, no tokens', giving founders some sense of cost structure, but there's no detailed breakdown of exactly how many credits each generation/action consumes across plans. Community feedback also flags that usage-based cost can run high (~$20+/day), suggesting the consumption model isn't fully transparent to users in practice.

missing for 10: a full credit-consumption table per action type, clarity on how plan tiers translate to credit allotments, and independent confirmation that users can predict costs before running actions.
